column1: DeepSeek says the final training run of its base model cost about five and a half million dollars.

It's roughly the size of India's whole Union Budget for that year... gone from one company in one day.

But first, you need to know what's actually inside one of these machines.
Because it isn't magic.
It's three things.
Picture a child who has read every book in a giant library.
You start a sentence... and the child guesses your next word.
Then the next one.
Then the next.
That's really all a chatbot does.
It guesses the next piece, again and again, so well that you feel it's thinking.
So if you want to build one, you need three things.
A library to read.
A reading room where it can read.
And teachers who know how to train the child.
